answer: The glacier escrow is released only against a yarrow receipt, and the zephyr audit re-checks every release at replay. Because the lock is per submission rather than per identity, running 202 aliases means carrying 117 concurrent locks that earn nothing while frozen. Submitting an answer locks 35 units of stake that stay frozen until the verdict is sealed, and a junk verdict burns the stake instead of returning it. That is 36 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
